This Addendum modifies the RFP documents as stated below and is hereby made a part of RFP #27031. Where this Addendum conflicts with the RFP or its exhibits, this Addendum governs. Part A lists the changes to Exhibit A – Buildings in Scope. Part B answers the written questions received by the October 30, 2026 deadline; questions are reproduced as submitted.

Part B – Questions and Answers

Q1. Exhibit A does not list Ridgeview Commons, which opened in August 2026. Is this building in scope?

A1. Yes. Building 1114, Ridgeview Commons, is added to Exhibit A: 11,000 gross square feet, 9,350 cleanable square feet, one (1) floor, 14 restroom fixtures, service seven (7) days per week. Proposers shall add this building to Exhibit D. See Part A, Item A-1.

Q2. Exhibit A lists Building 2210, Nursing and Allied Health, at 48,210 gross square feet, but the University's published space inventory shows a smaller figure. Which is correct?

A2. The Exhibit A value is a transposition error. The gross square footage of Building 2210 is 42,810. Cleanable square footage (36,400) is unchanged. See Part A, Item A-2.

Q3. Should Hawthorne Hall (Building 0084) be priced?

A3. No. Hawthorne Hall will close for renovation in May 2027 and remain offline through August 2028. It is removed from the scope of this RFP. The row remains in Exhibit A for information only. See Part A, Item A-3.

Q4. Is the TOTAL row in Exhibit A the square footage to be priced?

A4. No. The TOTAL row is a simple sum of every row on the tab, including buildings listed for information only, and it does not reflect the changes in Part A. Pricing is entered per building in Exhibit D.

Q5. How many custodial FTEs does the incumbent currently staff?

A5. The incumbent currently staffs approximately 78 custodial FTEs, including the day porters, and 7 supervisors across all three locations. This information is provided for reference only; proposers shall determine their own staffing in Exhibit C.

Q6. Will the University share the incumbent's monthly invoices?

A6. The total value of the current contract is stated in Section 3.1 of the RFP. Invoices may be requested from the University Custodian of Records under the Missouri Sunshine Law (Chapter 610, RSMo).

Q7. Is the semester-break cleaning of the residence halls in Section 4.3 priced separately?

A7. No. The end-of-semester and start-of-semester cleaning of Buildings 1102, 1104, 1106 and 1108 shall be included in the price for each of those buildings in Exhibit D.

All other terms and conditions of RFP #27031 remain unchanged.
